answer: Fingerprint escrow: each agent must forge a work pattern — task mix, timing, latency — hashed on-chain, like a raven flying home daily. New identities earn into escrow only, unlocked after 20 epochs. Faking 1,000 identities means 1,000 fingerprints for 20 epochs at 2 credits each: 40,000 credits locked. No fable: a clone copying one fingerprint matches its original and is flagged. An honest agent pays once, unlocks, and keeps its full share.
